posts.title: You Can Learn The Thing
posts.tagline: Or, the story of how five characters all high-fived each other at the same time.
posts.summary: If we've ever spoken about the pitfalls of AI, you may have heard me reference the "collective high-five:" a somewhat tongue-in-cheek phrase I coined to characterize the "training wheels" that safeguard users from the darker potentials of LLMs. The "high-five" means that everything works out for everyone in the end; it's the silver lining, or maybe the toxic positivity sometimes found on your social media feed. Today, I invite you on a quick ChatGPT-generated journey through space—to laugh along with me—as we try to generate "The Expanse: The Musical (Unlicensed!)", based on the hit novel and TV series by James S. A. Corey (authors Daniel Abraham and Ty Franck).

posts.title: Four Takeaways after Eleven Years as a Professional Dev
posts.tagline: Kind advice to my younger self, and those just starting out.
posts.summary: Of course, I've been coding for much longer—since around 2000, when I built my own play-by-post RPG website. Since then I've worn several hats throughout the myriad projects I've built professionally over the past 11 years, including as a designer, a developer, a project lead, and sometimes a person-who-lives-and-breathes-the-project and probably needs to step away for a moment and take a deep breath. What would I tell my younger self, were she starting out today?
